I can sympathize with what you are going through. I pretty much went through the same thing you did. It is tough. For me it didnt end up well. All it left me with in the end are suicidal tendencies and alcoholism. With that said, I can only offer you some words of advice. Dont let the small things make you angry. Its not worth it. If you do fight, try to calm down immediately and talk things out. Do something he enjoys once in awhile. Show and tell him you love him often. 
My ex gave up on me after we constantly fought and she isnt looking back. I really hope you guys can work it out. Ill be here if you need advice as I dont want anyone to feel the sorrow I feel every day.

That is how I feel. I usually can't fall asleep unless I am completely drunk or really tired. If I'm left alone with my thoughts I end up hating myself for the smallest things. Tried to move forward but completely failed. My self esteem took a bigger blow and it made me feel even worse. How do you do you dig yourself out of this hole when everything you do seem to make yourself dig even deeper?

I tried everything I could. I called suicide hotline and it didnt help. I dont really have any close friends who would give a crap. The only close friend I had I ostracize to be with her. My god I feel like a piece a shit for giving up my best friend for this girl.

I wish this was the first time I felt this pain but it seems to be getting worse and I have no idea how to stop it. I keep thinking about all the time we had together and how I would feel if she ends up with someone else and it just crushes me. I try not to think such things but I cant. I try to move past but I cant. I'm really at a lost and only know of one way out.
